evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from about 28,800 to about 6 ppm, and it has stayed there through the ramp and growth.
The thermocouple tracked the ramp setpoint within 1 °C, overshot to 760.5 °C when growth began, then settled at 750.0 °C.
Heater power rose steadily during the ramp, then dropped to about 40–45% for the hold, which fits holding temperature rather than ramping.
Pressure has held steady at about 3.0 Torr with Ar at 100 sccm.
Argon flow is within 1 sccm of setpoint.

args.missing_evidence: No normal-run reference values were provided, so the overshoot and hold power can't be checked against a baseline. Whether the target grew needs post-run characterization.
